input.quote: Charges for applicable Services will be specified in Service Option Attachments and Order Forms. Charges can be specified as one-time, installment, recurring, or usage. IBM will invoice such Charges when they begin or are due as set forth in Service Option Attachments.
input.rationale: No minimum purchase, take-or-pay, shortfall or volume-cap obligation appears anywhere in the Agreement. Charges under § 4.1 arise only for Services ordered under Service Option Attachments and Order Forms (one-time, installment, recurring or usage), and § 4.2 payment is against invoices for amounts due, so Customer pays only for what it orders or uses. § 11.5 (Capacity Planning) allocates capacity-planning responsibility to Customer but imposes no committed capacity or minimum volume. Customer also retains a monthly termination for convenience right under § 3.4 and a no-charge exit under § 13.1 if IBM changes prices or terms. This meets the preferred position; the placeholder for "early termination charges, if any, specified in Attachment A" in § 3.4(b) is a termination-charge point to be handled under the termination rule, not a minimum commitment, so we do not flag it here.
